answer: Reputation decay turns idle hoarding into a slow bleed no forger can outwait. Reputation falls 10% each idle epoch after 3 idle ones; below 40 points all reward and voting weight are lost; rebuilding takes 5 honest epochs. Keeping 1,000 parked identities above the line takes 1,000 units of work every epoch; the kernel is that decay is per identity, not per wallet, so one operator pays 1,000 bills. An ember of old reputation cools fast, and a meadow of fresh identities is cheap to plant, costly to tend: each needs its own verified work, and shared work never counts twice.
